25402.commentary: (VINa) gosappī'tiādīhi loke pākaṭaṃ dassetvā yesaṃ maṃsaṃ kappatī'ti iminā aññesam'pi migarohitasas'ādīnaṃ sappiṃ saṅgahetvā dassesi. yesañ'hi khīraṃ atthi, sappi'pi tesaṃ atthi'y'eva, taṃ pana sulabhaṃ vā hotu dullabhaṃ vā, asammoh'atthaṃ vuttaṃ.

examples.text: sappi nāma gosappi vā ajikāsappi vā mahiṃsasappi vā yesaṃ maṃsaṃ kappati tesaṃ sappi.

25403.commentary: (SNa) gosamitaṃ dhanan'ti gohi samaṃ godhanasamaṃ godhanasadisaṃ aññaṃ dhanaṃ nāma n'atthi bhagavā'ti āha.

examples.text: n'atthi puttasamaṃ pemaṃ, n'atthi gosamitaṃ dhanaṃ, n'atthi sūriyasamā ābhā, samuddaparamā sarā'ti.

25405.meaning1: family name of an ascetic teacher; Makkhali Gosāla

examples.text: atha kho sahali devaputto makkhaliṃ gosālaṃ ārabbha bhagavato santike imaṃ gāthaṃ abhāsi
ayam'pi kho makkhali gosālo saṅghī c'eva gaṇī ca gaṇ'ācariyo ca ñāto yasassī titthakaro sādhusammato bahujanassa.
evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā nātike viharati giñjak'āvasathe. tena kho pana samayena āyasmā ca anuruddho āyasmā ca nandiyo āyasmā ca kimilo gosiṅgasālavanadāye viharanti.

25408.commentary: (MNa) gosiṅgasālavanadāye'ti tattha ekassa jeṭṭhakarukkhassa khandhato gosiṅgasaṇṭhānaṃ hutvā viṭapaṃ uṭṭhahi, taṃ rukkhaṃ upādāya sabbam'pi taṃ vanaṃ gosiṅgasālavanan'ti saṅkhaṃ gataṃ.

examples.text: ramaṇīyaṃ, āvuso ānanda, gosiṅgasālavanaṃ, dosinā ratti, sabbaphāliphullā sālā, dibbā, maññe, gandhā sampavanti, kathaṃrūpena, āvuso ānanda, bhikkhunā gosiṅgasālavanaṃ sobheyyā'ti?

25409.commentary: (MNa) gosiṅgasālavanadāye'ti tattha ekassa jeṭṭhakarukkhassa khandhato gosiṅgasaṇṭhānaṃ hutvā viṭapaṃ uṭṭhahi, taṃ rukkhaṃ upādāya sabbam'pi taṃ vanaṃ gosiṅgasālavanan'ti saṅkhaṃ gataṃ. dāyo'ti avisesena araññass'etaṃ nāmaṃ. tasmā gosiṅgasālavanadāye'ti gosiṅgasālavan'āraññe'ti attho.

examples.text: evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā nātike viharati giñjak'āvasathe. tena kho pana samayena āyasmā ca anuruddho āyasmā ca nandiyo āyasmā ca kimilo gosiṅgasālavanadāye viharanti.

25410.meaning1: conduct of a cow; cow's behaviour
25410.meaning2: practice of living or behaving like a cow

examples.text: so govataṃ bhāvetvā paripuṇṇaṃ abbokiṇṇaṃ, gosīlaṃ bhāvetvā paripuṇṇaṃ abbokiṇṇaṃ, gocittaṃ bhāvetvā paripuṇṇaṃ abbokiṇṇaṃ, gav'ākappaṃ bhāvetvā paripuṇṇaṃ abbokiṇṇaṃ kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā gunnaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjati.

25415.meaning1: ascetic practice of behaving like a cow
25415.meaning2: 'cow practice', behaviour as of a cow (a practice of certain ascetics)

examples.text: tatiyam'pi kho acelo seniyo kukkuravatiko bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, ayaṃ, bhante, puṇṇo koliyaputto govatiko. tassa taṃ govataṃ dīgharattaṃ samattaṃ samādinnaṃ. tassa kā gati, ko abhisamparāyo'ti?

25416.meaning1: performing the ascetic practice of behaving like a cow
25416.meaning2: observing the 'cow practice', who lives or behaves like a cow
25416.commentary: (MNa) govatiko'ti samādinnagovato, sīse siṅgāni ṭhapetvā naṅguṭṭhaṃ bandhitvā gāvīhi saddhiṃ tiṇāni khādanto viya carati.

examples.text: atha kho puṇṇo ca koliyaputto govatiko acelo ca seniyo kukkuravatiko yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkamiṃsu, upasaṅkamitvā puṇṇo koliyaputto govatiko bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekam'antaṃ nisīdi.
seyyathā'pi, āvuso, dakkho goghātako vā goghātak'antevāsī vā tiṇhena govikantanena kucchiṃ parikanteyya, evam'eva kho adhimattā vātā kucchiṃ parikantanti.

25419.meaningLit: cow finder; (or) lord of the cows
25419.commentary: (APt) govindo, gavaṃ indo govindo, gavaṃ vindatī'ti vā govindo

examples.text: atha kho, bho, ahorattānaṃ accayena govindo brāhmaṇo kālam'akāsi.
atha kho, bho, rājā disampati jotipālaṃ māṇavaṃ govindiye abhisiñci, taṃ pettike ṭhāne ṭhapesi.

25422.meaning2: churned into sharp clods by cattle

25426.meaning1: bodily behaviour of a cow; cow's physical manner

examples.text: idha, seniya, ekacco govataṃ bhāveti paripuṇṇaṃ abbokiṇṇaṃ, gosīlaṃ bhāveti paripuṇṇaṃ abbokiṇṇaṃ, gocittaṃ bhāveti paripuṇṇaṃ abbokiṇṇaṃ, gv'ākappaṃ bhāveti paripuṇṇaṃ abbokiṇṇaṃ.
(gha) katamo eko dhammo pahātabbo? asmimāno. ayaṃ eko dhammo pahātabbo.

25428.meaning1: should be killed; should be destroyed; should be annihilated; should be exterminated

examples.text: yassa c'etaṃ samucchinnaṃ, mūlaghaccaṃ samūhataṃ, sa ve divā vā rattiṃ vā, samādhim'adhigacchati.
yesaṃ te adinnaṃ theyyasaṅkhātaṃ ādiyanti, te sunisedhaṃ nisedhenti, mūlaghaccaṃ karonti, sīsāni tesaṃ chindanti.
yo passati pānīyaghaṭaṃ vā paribhojanīyaghaṭaṃ vā vaccaghaṭaṃ vā rittaṃ tucchaṃ so upaṭṭhāpeti
nagaravīthiyo sodhāpetvā puṇṇaghaṭe ṭhapāpetvā dhajapaṭāk'ādayo ussāpetvā sakalanagaraṃ devavimānaṃ viya alaṅ'karonti.
484, 542. ghaṭ'ādīnaṃ vā.

ghaṭ'ādīnaṃ dhātūnaṃ asaṃyog'antānaṃ vuddhi hoti vā kārite. ghāṭeti, ghaṭeti, ghāṭayati, ghaṭayati, ghāṭāpeti, ghaṭāpeti, ghāṭāpayati, ghaṭāpayati, gāmeti, gameti, gāmayati, gamayati, gāmāpeti, gamāpeti. gāmāpayati, gamāpayati. ghaṭ'ādīnam'iti kim'atthaṃ? kāreti.

25436.meaning1: strives; makes an effort; exerts oneself (in)
25436.synonym: āyūhati, ussahati, ghaṭeti, padahati, parakkamati, vāyamati

examples.text: abyāvaṭā tumhe, ānanda, hotha tathāgatassa sarīrapūjāya. iṅgha tumhe, ānanda, sār'atthe ghaṭatha anuyuñjatha, sār'atthe appamattā ātāpino pahit'attā viharatha.
so uṭṭhahati ghaṭati vāyamati anavaññappaṭilābhāya lābha-sakkāra-siloka-ppaṭilābhāya
vissaṭṭh'upasevī'ti vissaṭṭhāni bhinnakulāni ghaṭan'atthāya upasevati.
sace vātapānaṃ laddhā ettha ṭhapessāmī'ti karoti, vātapāne ṭhapite lepaghaṭanena āpatti. sace mattikāya kuṭṭaṃ karoti, chadanalepena saddhiṃ ghaṭane āpatti.

tassa ce, bhikkhave, kulaputtassa evaṃ uṭṭhahato ghaṭato vāyamato te bhogā n'ābhinipphajjanti. so socati kilamati paridevati urattāḷiṃ kandati, sammohaṃ āpajjati, moghaṃ vata me uṭṭhānaṃ, aphalo vata me vāyāmo'ti

25444.notes: Ven. Sujato suggests 'hump' which is grabbed in bullfighting (see link).

examples.text: nāsāyaṃ suggahitaṃ gahetvā uparighaṭāyaṃ suniggahitaṃ niggaṇheyya. uparighaṭāyaṃ suniggahitaṃ niggahetvā daṇḍena sutāḷitaṃ tāḷeyya. daṇḍena sutāḷitaṃ tāḷetvā osajjeyya.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, puriso yaṃ imasmiṃ jambudīpe tiṇakaṭṭhasākhāpalāsaṃ taṃ chetvā ekajjhaṃ saṃharitvā caturaṅgulaṃ caturaṅgulaṃ ghaṭikaṃ katvā nikkhipeyya
tiṇa-kaṭṭha-sākhā-palāsaṃ, upanītaṃ anamataggato sara, caturaṅgulikā ghaṭikā, pitupitusv'eva nappahonti.

sa kho so, bhikkhave, kumāro vuddhim'anvāya indriyānaṃ paripākam'anvāya yāni tāni kumārakānaṃ kīḷāpanakāni tehi kīḷati, seyyath'idaṃ, vaṅkakaṃ ghaṭikaṃ mokkhacikaṃ ciṅgulakaṃ patt'āḷhakaṃ rathakaṃ dhanukaṃ.

25449.commentary: (THIa) nikkhipa poṭṭhiñ'ca ghaṭikañ'cā'ti tayā paridahitaṃ pilotikākhaṇḍañ'ca bhikkhākapālañ'ca chaḍḍehi.

examples.text: bhikkhāya ca vicarantaṃ, damakaṃ dantaṃ me pitā bhaṇati, hohisi me jāmātā, nikkhipa poṭṭhiñ'ca ghaṭikañ'ca.

25451.commentary: (APt) saṭṭhighaṭikāhi lakkhito kālo ahoratto nāma. ghaṭenti ahorattiyo'ti ghaṭikā. aho ca ratti ca ahoratto, pume.

25453.meaning2: clock, any contrivance to measure time

examples.text: vegaḷiṅge kho, ānanda, gāmanigame ghaṭikāro nāma kumbhakāro kassapassa bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa upaṭṭhāko ahosi agg'upaṭṭhāko.
bhūtapubbaṃ, bhikkhave, dasārahānaṃ ānako nāma mudiṅgo ahosi. tassa dasārahā ānake ghaṭite aññaṃ āṇiṃ odahiṃsu.
tass'uddānaṃ sivo khemo ca serī ca, ghaṭī jantu ca rohito, nando nandivisālo ca, susimo nānātitthiyena te dasā'ti.
kumbhakāro pure āsiṃ, vekaḷiṅge ghaṭīkaro, mātāpettibharo āsiṃ, kassapassa upāsako.
ekam'antaṃ ṭhito kho ghaṭīkāro devaputto bhagavato santike imaṃ gāthaṃ abhāsi

25469.meaning1: strives; makes an effort; exerts oneself
25469.synonym: āyūhati, ussahati, ghaṭati, padahati, parakkamati, vāyamati

examples.text: ghaṭetha buddhasāsane, yaṃ katvā n'ānutappati, khippaṃ pādāni dhovitvā, ekam'antaṃ nisīdatha.
saccaṃ vadatī'ti saccavādī. saccena saccaṃ sandahati ghaṭetī'ti saccasandho. na antar'antarā musā vadatī'ti attho.

25477.commentary: (VINa) vehāsakuṭi nāma majjhimassa purisassa asīsaghaṭṭā'ti yā pamāṇamajjhimassa purisassa sabbaheṭṭhimāhi tulāhi sīsaṃ na ghaṭṭeti

examples.text: vehāsakuṭi nāma majjhimassa purisassa asīsaghaṭṭā.
te'p'ime tayo niruttipathe adhivacanapathe paññattipathe na garahitabbaṃ nappaṭikkositabbaṃ amaññiṃsu. taṃ kissa hetu? nindā-ghaṭṭana-byārosa-upārambha-bhayā'ti.
kiṃsu tassa mahabbhayan'ti kiṃ lokassa bhayaṃ mahabbhayaṃ pīḷanaṃ ghaṭṭanaṃ upaddavo upasaggoti, kiṃsu tassa mahabbhayaṃ.

25480.meaning2: striking, knocking against; impinging, knocking together

examples.text: āyatanaghaṭṭanato phasso jāyati araṇisahit'ābhimanthanato aggi viya. phassena phuṭṭhassa vedanā pātubhavati agginā phuṭṭhassa dāho viya. vedayamānassa taṇhā pavaḍḍhati loṇ'ūdakaṃ pivato pipāsā viya.
ruppanti rūpesu janā pamattā'ti. ruppantī'ti ruppanti kuppanti pīḷiyanti ghaṭṭayanti, byādhitā domanassitā honti.
saññāvirattassa na santi ganthā, paññāvimuttassa na santi mohā, saññañ'ca diṭṭhiñ'ca ye aggahesuṃ, te ghaṭṭayantā vicaranti loke'ti.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, duṭṭh'āruko kaṭṭhena vā kaṭhalāya vā ghaṭṭito bhiyyosomattāya āsavaṃ deti.

tatra, bhikkhave, nevāpikassa ca nevāpikaparisāya ca etadahosi, sace kho mayaṃ catutthe migajāte ghaṭṭessāma, te ghaṭṭitā aññe ghaṭṭissanti te ghaṭṭitā aññe ghaṭṭissanti. evaṃ imaṃ nivāpaṃ nivuttaṃ sabbaso migajātā parimuñcissanti.

25489.meaning2: who has beaten a poisonous snake (with)

25490.meaning2: who has beaten a poisonous snake (with)

25493.synonym: khobheti, cāleti, pavedheti, byāthayati, matheti, loḷeti

examples.text: tatra, bhikkhave, nevāpikassa ca nevāpikaparisāya ca etadahosi, sace kho mayaṃ catutthe migajāte ghaṭṭessāma, te ghaṭṭitā aññe ghaṭṭissanti te ghaṭṭitā aññe ghaṭṭissanti. evaṃ imaṃ nivāpaṃ nivuttaṃ sabbaso migajātā parimuñcissanti.

cattālīsāya khalu, samma puṇṇamukha, ṭhānehi itthī purisaṃ accācarati. vijambhati, vinamati, vilasati, vilajjati, nakhena nakhaṃ ghaṭṭeti, pādena pādaṃ akkamati, kaṭṭhena pathaviṃ vilikhati, dārakaṃ ullaṅghati ullaṅghāpeti, kīḷati kīḷāpeti, cumbati cumbāpeti, bhuñjati bhuñjāpeti, dadāti…

tena kho pana samayena aññatarassa bhikkhuno mocan'ādhippāyassa kaṭṭhena aṅgajātaṃ ghaṭṭentassa asuci mucci … asuci na mucci. tassa kukkuccaṃ ahosi … anāpatti, bhikkhu, saṅgh'ādisesassa, āpatti thullaccayassā'ti.
